emma: Heads up — HF -> Redwood conversion failing on the new instruction-tuned model. Load error from runtime: 'kv cache shape mismatch' and 'position id out of range'.

raja: can you paste the config.json snippet? guessing it's one of the common incompat fields (rope_scaling / sliding_window / num_key_value_heads / max_position_embeddings).

emma: yep, here are the fields we got from HF config (trimmed):
```json
"hidden_size": 4096,
"num_attention_heads": 32,
"num_key_value_heads": 8,
"max_position_embeddings": 4096,
"rope_scaling": {"type":"linear","factor":1.5},
"sliding_window": 256
```

sylvie: that rope_scaling + sliding_window combo rings bell. Redwood runtime assumes fixed max_position by default and KV cache indexing doesn't support HF-style sliding_window.

jun: also num_key_value_heads != num_attention_heads is fine conceptually but our conversion expects either the explicit kv heads mapping or the model to expose an attribute. If missing, we fall back to num_attention_heads which breaks shapes.

emma: conversion log from rw-convert: "ERROR: incompatible_config_fields: rope_scaling unsupported; sliding_window will be ignored; kv cache shape (batch, seq, num_kv_heads, head_dim) mismatch"

model-onboard-bot: Conversion pipeline status: FAILED (step=runtime-compat-check). Incompatible keys: rope_scaling, sliding_window, num_key_value_heads (ambiguous), max_position_embeddings (exceeds rw default).

raja: Quick mitigation options:
- override max_position_embeddings to a smaller safe value (e.g., 2048) during conversion
- strip rope_scaling and bake it into the weights (if feasible) or set to null to use default rotary handling
- set sliding_window -> false and rely on Redwood prefix cache + chunking logic
- explicitly set num_key_value_heads = num_attention_heads or provide kv_head_ratio in conversion config

emma: trying an override now: `rw-convert --from-hf ./hf-model --to-rw ./rw-model --set max_position_embeddings=2048 --set sliding_window=false --set num_key_value_heads=32`

jun: if you force num_key_value_heads=32 but the underlying model expects compressed KV heads, you'll change parameter shapes. Better to set a kv_head_ratio or run a small sanity init that checks linear layer shapes.

emma: new run produced a different error: `RuntimeError: linear weight shape mismatch when remapping kv projection`

raja: ok that's the shape problem. Two approaches we've used: 1) remap weights by splitting/joining heads during conversion (script below), or 2) ask model authors for a HF checkpoint with explicit 'k_proj'/'v_proj' shapes matching expectation.

sylvie: conversion helper snippet we used before (very rough):
```python
# split merged k/v into separate tensors if attention heads mismatch
def remap_kv(weight, num_attn, num_kv):
    head_dim = weight.shape[-1] // num_attn
    if num_kv == num_attn:
        return weight
    ratio = num_attn // num_kv
    weight = weight.reshape(num_attn, ratio, head_dim)
    return weight.mean(axis=1)  # crude, prefer deterministic split
```

jun: note — that mean trick will change model behavior. Prefer deterministic reshape + reorder (no averaging) if possible. Also add a test that runs a short prompt through HF and Redwood-converted models and diff logits to spot regressions.

emma: for immediate QA I disabled rope_scaling and set sliding_window=false, used remap script to expand kv heads. Model loads but we see increased perplexity on eval - looks like rotary scaling had an effect.

raja: yeah rope_scaling modifies rotary positional frequency — dropping it will alter early-token conditioning. If you can't bake it into weights, a conversion-time transform that rescales rotary matrices is needed. Might be messy.

sylvie: proposed follow-up: create a small checklist for HF->RW conversions that flags these keys: rope_scaling, sliding_window, num_key_value_heads != num_attention_heads, max_position_embeddings > rw_default. Also add an automated pre-check in rw-convert that either auto-applies safe transforms or warns with exact remediation commands.

emma: filing an onboarding issue with logs + config + small repro prompts. @raja can you add the remap helper to the conversion utils? @jun can you add a warning message for rope_scaling cases?

raja: yup will PR a remap util and a test.

jun: I'll add the rope_scaling detection and a suggested bake/approx path in the error output.

model-onboard-bot: Issue created: RW-ONBOARD-412 (hf-config-incompat). Attach logs and repro.

emma: thanks — keeping this thread for context. If anyone runs into similar model (long pos + kv head mismatch) ping here. :white_check_mark:
